threads.body: [Testing] The new javaagent opt-in variant is not listed in `.github/scripts/instrumentations.sh`, which currently runs only `sofa-rpc-5.4:javaagent:testSofaRpc`. Because the actual SofaRPC tests live in the custom suite, metadata collection will never execute `testSofaRpcExceptionSignalLogs` and therefore will not observe the new log signal. Add that task next to the existing SofaRPC entry.

[Testing] This helper hides a short mode-dependent expectation away from each span assertion. Repository test convention keeps these branches inline so every assertion visibly states the expected behavior for both exception-signal modes. Inline `emitExceptionAsSpanEvents() ? exception : null` at the call sites and remove this helper.
[Testing] Nullability annotations are not used in test code in this repository. The nullable case is already made explicit by the `serverException != null` branch, so remove `@Nullable` here.
